onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

run.Description: the run number where each run generally represents a unique parameter space

contacts.Description: the stimulation contacts and polarities used on the stim electrode

contact_negative.Description: the negative (cathodal) contact for a trial

contact_negative_coord.Description: the ccf coordinate for the cathodal contact

contact_positive_coord.Description: the ccf coordinate for the anodal contact

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
Levels.epochs: The 'epochs' table in the NWB file.
